DIAGNOSIS READY: Gastric Malignancy (Stomach Cancer)

Your history of heavy smoking, significant weight loss, night sweats, and a fixed supraclavicular lymph node, combined with worsening abdominal pain, strongly points to an upper gastrointestinal malignancy, likely originating in the stomach. The definitive diagnosis and staging will rely on the CT scan and blood work I ordered, which are pending review.
